action.instructions: Which single action should the player character take next in this top-down game?

criteria.attack_target: Basic-attack the nearest group when it is within distance 1.
criteria.skill_on_target: Use the ready skill when several groups are within its range.
criteria.kite_back: Back off to push every group away when too many are close.
criteria.drink_potion: Drink a potion when health is low and a potion is left.
criteria.hold: Do nothing when no action is useful yet.

danger.instructions: How much immediate danger is the player in, before taking the next action? Assess the current state, not the result of the action you would choose.
criteria: Safe: holding still for the next two turns costs no health.
Threatened: holding still costs health next turn, but not this turn.
Critical: holding still costs health this turn, or the player is about to be defeated.

incoming_attack.instructions: If the player chooses hold this turn, will an enemy group bite the player? Answer based only on the supplied state.
